result.brief: 提出三阶段框架 PhyS，通过物理交互数据集、物理感知微调与在线强化学习（含 Temporal Credit Routing），将物理先验蒸馏进轻量因果流式世界模型，提升长时序物理一致性。
result.reason: Streaming causal world model with physical priors, autoregressive few-step generation, and RL for physical plausibility directly matches video world model and video generation directions.
